verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox publicly states only a starting monthly price ('Plans from $9.99 per month') and that online storage is free and unlimited. Check deposit is mentioned only as available at select locations, with no fee. The evidence shows no complete plan price table and no per-item fee schedule. Missing for 10: full per-plan monthly prices, scan allowances per plan, per-item fees for extra scans, forwarding fees, physical item storage fees, check deposit fees.

support.subject: As a founder, plan pricing is public and complete — monthly price, scan allowances, and the per-item fees for extra scans, forwarding, storage, and check deposit
